summary: Lane retrovalidation/plague (Fable; J392). research/sf/plague-system.md read whole (1,085 lines) before any ruling; the verifier's 11 findings re-checked at the host 81f1cd96 by re-opening every cited line (HEAD read from .git/HEAD → refs/heads/master; no git command). All 11 ACCEPTED; 3 with an amended fix: F2 (the crime-pressure path into true embattlement is real, but crime's whole weight 0.3 sits under the 0.55 enter threshold and embattlement.js:84-86 says high crime sustains, never initiates, an embattlement — so a DM plague can hold or raise an already-embattled region, never start one; and the scalar it nudges is read by the movers' route re-score and banditry, not only the roads' known view), F10 (the verifier's sentence lacked the DM exception the note keeps for plague: condition promotion maps both magic names to the magical_instability condition, activeConditions.js:158-165, which drains healing at once), F11 (the "priceable folly" sentence is at PHASE55:1631, not :1633). F6 confirmed WRONG in part: pulseKernel.js:670 writes the population_friction history from agedStressors.graduated and :1996 emits the graduation news; the echo's footprint collapses to the origin (stressorsCore.js:489). Own findings beyond the verifier: the embattlement sizing; the DM exception; the PHASE55 line; and one dated bracket where §1 and §8.4 call an unmapped realm "the default preset's usual state" — true of the host today but, under J384 (6) and V13 H22 (rulings.md UPHELD), the exception for a world born from this module. Readings tested and sound: the 26-tick "recovery floor" is a ceiling on the active phase (pestilence.js:533-536, host name RECOVERY_FLOOR_TICKS); aging precedes candidates and skips nothing at age 0 (pulseKernel.js:509-512; stressors.js:351-379); the J377–J382 readings cite the rows' session readings, not the owner's words, correctly. Amendments j 131–141 and i 130 touch nothing the note claims. 23 readings judged: 20 UPHELD, 2 AMENDED (§9 item 3; the unmapped-realm reading), 0 OVERTURNED, 1 NOT-A-RULING. 16 research corrections (every old string present exactly once); no design fragment (V13 §5.9 :3223 says only that the host's plague reads no border, march, patrol or army, which holds; no design text restates a corrected claim); no record fragment (no J-row of J375–J391 repeats F2 or F6, so J392 names nothing from this lane). The note's conclusions hold. Record: docs/validation/retrovalidation-2026-10-18/plague.md; LANDED line appended 01:20 UTC.
